title: The Great War, Armageddon
body:
(..weak audio...) A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Allah, Allah ... yaa RijaalAllah. He is coming
from Africa to meet Grandshaykh (q), but he passed away. I am inheriting his cape. ... come down … he was
signing to ... Kenya. Kenya, yes. O yaa Rabbee, madad yaa Sultan al-Awliya. Tariqatuna as-suhbah.
Grandshaykh said the main pillar of most-distinguished Sufi Order is Sayyidina Shah Naqshband (q). May
Allah bless you! The Naqshbandi Order is standing up like a staff, and our Grandshaykh (q) is the last and
complete, Allah's blessings on him. We hope that we will meet him here, before the Hereafter.
Coming is `asrul-ajaa'ib wal-gharaa'ib, the time of mysteries and wonders; ghufran, Sayyidina Muhammad
(s). This is up to the time of Mahdi (a) and will be on sunnatullah, natural laws or rules. It was only for
prophets and saints, saying time-by-time they were cutting that and showing qudratullah, the Heavenly
Power. Ordinarily no one was using it except prophets when they called people to believe in them. People
asked them, “What is your proof that you have been sent by Allah Almighty?” And then Allah Almighty
authorized them with miraculous power that belong to Heavens, khaariqan lil-`adaat, "breaking the usual."
But in the 20th century awliya were enabled and they were using that miraculous power. After the second
World War, it is finished; only one, Grandshaykh (q), was using it.
One must be always trying not to be hopeless; one must be clear. Sayyidina Mahdi (a) is Saahib al-Karamaat,

"Master of Miracles." He will use all miraculous powers; natural rules will end, all the usual rules will break,
and unusual powers will come. The first to break will be technology, making it rubbish and throwing it in the
ocean because Mankind is too proud with technology and trembling! Huuuuu. That time now is reaching,
and when a great war begins it will carry up to Mahdi (a), known as "Armageddon" in other holy books. When
it begins that miraculous power, all authorized awliya will begin to use that power. I was there and
Grandshaykh said something about that power and good tidings for people. Everyone who wears a turban,
nothing (bad) will come on him, finished!
O People with heavenly turbans! It is impossible, even if bombs fall like rain, they will never come on him! No
one can be touched by Armageddon if he is wearing a turban. Angels and jinn will give directions to destroy
huge weapons. They are saying the Patriarch is bringing it down, and second will be Russians, (then) the
Scots. Yes, it is true. Understanding? It will be protected, everyone. If you fear, a beard is not enough, shalwar
is not enough, but the turban, the crown of Prophet (s) is enough! For ladies, hijab will protect them, but
women and men with uncovered heads will go away. Who wears a turban can't be touched, not by a bullet or
anything (to injure him). He will be protected and surrounded with heavenly powers, because heavenly
powers will be enabled from the beginning of Armageddon. Qudratullah will be enabled at the time of Mahdi,
(a), may Allah grant to you at this time. All sahaabah (r) were asking, and after them all awliyas are asking to
be in the time of Mahdi (a), but it is passing through a very difficult tunnel. You can't imagine the fear and the
terribleness of that tunnel through which people pass to reach the time of Mahdi (a)!
Now step by step, the whole world is approaching what Grandshaykh refers to as "the Great War of
Armageddon." It will happen suddenly when people are speaking of peace, and I was wondering, when will be
the time of peace? If we are saying our time is in peace, nothing happens. So many things are going on, but
how will it be? Now I understand, before the Iraqi Gulf War started, people were talking about and hoping for
peace, but that big war came suddenly and no one could prevent it. Suddenly, every balance is going to be
changed. Suddenly, every idea for peace is going to be changed into war. Suddenly, people's minds are going
to be changed towards war. Suddenly, the hearts of people are going to be prepared for war! Muqallib alquloob, who is looking after the hearts of servants, in a second changes the hearts of all people, and it will be
what the Seal of Prophets (s) said about it; this world will be changed and people will be renewed. Everything
needs renewment and that renewment will come with Mahdi (a)!

Soon all things are going to be prepared. Therefore, I am looking after `Eid to the month of Shawwal, at what
will happen in Shawwal, Dhul Qa`dah, Dhul Hijjah, up to 10th Muharram. If the Divine Order is coming on
10th Muharram, Sayyidina Mahdi (a) must come! And so many people are just delivered from here to the
Hereafter, billions will be transferred and a new generation is coming. Once Grandshaykh showed me at
night a view he was attending for a ceremony somewhere. And in front of him was passing someone new,
with a short beard, young people by the millions. He said to me, "O my son! These are those whom you will
reach, to look after them, mostly from Russia." They are blond people, and I watched them. "They will be
saved, blessed, and protected. They are coming to be for Mahdi (a)." Then I understood that those growing up
to twenty years old, mostly they will be protected. After that, up to thirty years old will be half protected; up
to forty years old a lot of people will be protected; after reaching forty years of age, mostly men will be taken
from that generation, not women.
What I mean to say is, renewment is coming and all people after forty years, mostly their minds and their
hearts are occupied by shaytanic ideas and they have no more good attributes or characteristics, which is
difficult to change. Therefore, they will be transferred to akhirah, to the Next Life. Only who have been
changed, and who keeps the ways of tariqahs will be protected and will be with Sayyidina Mahdi (a)! But
mostly new ones and youngsters will be protected, as no account is written for them up to twenty years; they
remain clean.
May Allah forgive us and clean us! Cleanliness is a main condition for being protected. Dirty ones will never
be protected as they are put in the dustbin and taken away. Try to be clean ones with clean minds, hearts,
bodies, tongues, work, and clean intention! If not, like garbage, you will be taken away. Who becomes
unclean cannot be at the time of Mahdi (a), when there will be no more unclean people; only there will be
Paradise people at the time of Mahdi (a) and no more Hell's people, finished! May Allah grant you to be
Paradise people, and forgive me.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Ilaa sharafan Nabi...
